newsitem.title: USA: Dow skids in initial moments of session.
newsitem.headline: Dow skids in initial moments of session.

text.p: Wall Street stocks suffered broad losses in early trade on Monday, with the Dow industrials tumbling nearly 50 points.
The Dow was off 42 points 6480 after slipping as many as 48 points in the first half-hour of activity. The Nasdaq Composite fell four points to 1289.

"This appears to be a reaction to weakness in Treasuries," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co. "We're also seeing some profit-taking in bigger stocks, which are starting to be turned for mid-caps and smaller stocks."
